newsitem.title: USA: Starter gets contract with nine NBA teams.
newsitem.headline: Starter gets contract with nine NBA teams.

text.p: Starter Corp said it has entered into a five-year agreement with the National Basketball Association's NBA Properties to be the exclusive manufacturer and marketer of apparel for nine NBA teams from the 1997-98 season, the company said in a statement Friday.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The apparel covered under the agreement includes Pro Cut and authentic game jerseys and shorts, shooting shirts, practicewear and warm-ups.

Under the agreement, Starter will outfit the following teams: Charlotte Hornets, Cleveland Cavaliers, Denver Nuggets, Golden State Warriors, Houston Rockets, Milwaukee Bucks, Minnesota Timberwolves, New York Knicks and Sacramento Kings.
Starter said it will also provide local support to each team with advertising and retail promotion in conjunction with the NBA.
